INSERT INTO stripe_payment_runs (
  stripe_event_id,
  payment_intent_id,
  amount_cents,
  currency,
  customer_email,
  slack_status,
  airtable_status,
  resend_status,
  slack_error,
  airtable_error,
  resend_error,
  overall_status,
  raw_event,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.stripe_event_id }}',
  '{{ $json.payment_intent_id }}',
  '{{ $json.amount_cents }}'::integer,
  '{{ $json.currency }}',
  '{{ $json.customer_email }}',
  '{{ $json.slack_status }}',
  '{{ $json.airtable_status }}',
  '{{ $json.resend_status }}',
  '{{ $json.slack_error }}',
  '{{ $json.airtable_error }}',
  '{{ $json.resend_error }}',
  '{{ $json.overall_status }}',
  '{{ $json.raw_event }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (stripe_event_id) DO UPDATE SET
  payment_intent_id = EXCLUDED.payment_intent_id,
  amount_cents      = EXCLUDED.amount_cents,
  currency          = EXCLUDED.currency,
  customer_email    = EXCLUDED.customer_email,
  slack_status      = EXCLUDED.slack_status,
  airtable_status   = EXCLUDED.airtable_status,
  resend_status     = EXCLUDED.resend_status,
  slack_error       = EXCLUDED.slack_error,
  airtable_error    = EXCLUDED.airtable_error,
  resend_error      = EXCLUDED.resend_error,
  overall_status    = EXCLUDED.overall_status,
  raw_event         = EXCLUDED.raw_event,
  processed_at      = EXCLUDED.processed_at,
  retry_count       = stripe_payment_runs.retry_count + 1;
